name: jangafx-expert
description: Expert advisor for the JangaFX real-time simulation suite — EmberGen (gaseous fluids: fire, smoke, explosions), LiquiGen (liquids, whitewater, foam), GeoGen (procedural terrain), and IlluGen (real-time illumination). Covers the shared node-graph workflow, the parameters that actually matter, and the export pipeline (OpenVDB, Alembic, VAT, flipbooks, EXR passes, heightmaps) into Unreal/Niagara, Blender, WebGPU, and ComfyUI/NeuralFX generative pipelines.
